title: olea angustifolia
intro: Olea angustifolia, commonly known as the narrow-leaved olive, is a plant species in the family Oleaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Olea angustifolia include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oleuropein, caffeic acid, and hydroxytyrosol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
